statements: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS onering_requests (request_identity TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, request_hash TEXT NOT NULL, snapshot_hash TEXT NOT NULL, idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL, created_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_onering_requests_idempotency ON onering_requests (idempotency_key);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS onering_snapshots (snapshot_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, request_identity TEXT NOT NULL, canonical_json TEXT NOT NULL, created_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_onering_snapshots_request ON onering_snapshots (request_identity);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS onering_temp_store (temp_key_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, request_identity TEXT NOT NULL, namespace TEXT NOT NULL, payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL, expires_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL, purgeable INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (purgeable = 1));
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_onering_temp_store_request ON onering_temp_store (request_identity);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_onering_temp_store_expiry ON onering_temp_store (expires_at_utc);
